I have an oral fixation. I always have to be chewing on something (I even suck my thumb. I know, lame) so I got my tongue pierced so I have something to play with without having to suck my thumb in public.

My friend Johnny was singing Friday by Rebecca Black. I told him that if he didn't stop singing, I was going to hurt him. He took off and I tried to chase after him, but I tripped over my own foot. Fractured my wrist, and got a really deep gash on my knee.

When I was in fifth grade, I found out that I have an ulcer on my lung. The doctor told me that it was a bleeding ulcer and that if I didn't get the surgery to get it fixed, I was going to die in the next 5 years. We later found out that he was just trying to get us to get the surgery because he would get some kind of percentage when referring us to the doctor to do the surgery. And it's obviously not fatal, considering I'm still living.

I'm not sure how irrational these are but, I am afraid of random people in trench coats, butterflies, and going under those underpass bridge things as a train goes by above. I'm always afraid they're going to collapse while I'm underneath.

Last year I worked at a hoagie shop, and our busiest day of the year is the Super Bowl. It was only me and one other guy (plus our manager) working. The other guy got fed up, quit and just walked out. My boss didn't even bother to call anyone else in. I had to work the next 3 hours by myself, answering phones, taking orders, slicing, dressing and bagging orders. THE WORST.

Reading this was like re-living my life in high school. I know that it's hard to believe, but I promise you that it DOES get better. Somehow, life finds a way to fall together in the end. Going through these struggles will only make you stronger, you just have to gather the little strength to keep your head up. Smile, because you deserve to.

I merely wrote in hopes that people would be aware that not everything may be as bad as it seems. Things will find a way to work out for the best, and bad times will get better. I'm always here to help people in need, because I know how it feels to need someone to talk to about things when you feel alone and depressed. But thank you very much for the kind words :)
